annotation.title: All these passives could be in a nice row

result: R20, C10, C9 and C7 form one vertical-footprint row at 2.5 mm pitch, y=82.5 mm. Only R20 and C10 moved. C9 and C7 and the ADC pin decouplers retain their original placement and copper.
tools: tesla_route_reviewed.py (existing reviewed copper replay; rotation needs reconstructed local routes rather than endpoint dragging)
quality_assessment: All 288 error diagnostics are identical to the unchanged-board AUX review baseline; this focused alignment does not resolve the existing whole-board quality backlog.

Warning count remains 2401. Most diagnostic changes are updated distances from moved bulk capacitor C10 / rail link R20 to all other pads on the shared supply; these are not intended local bypass pairings. Individual IC bypass capacitors and their return paths are unchanged.
Existing 0.12 mm passive silkscreen-width warnings follow the same moved footprints. No library geometry was changed.
Info count decreases from 23 to 22. Complete remaining findings are in adc-passive-row-checks/quality.json; prior assessment is in aux-connector-rows-review.json.
visual_review: Reviewed actual copper/footprint preview for the marked ADC area: regular row and orientation, aligned capacitor ground vias, centered straight pad exits and 45/90 degree transitions; no newly dangling copper or local overlap visible.
No parts or 3D models changed. No external fabrication/assembly preview or fabrication publish requested; board remains a draft.
